summary: Kisin proves the Langlands–Rapoport conjecture, up to a twist by a cocycle, for the mod p points of Shimura varieties of abelian type at hyperspecial level (p > 2): each isogeny class has the form predicted by an admissible morphism, and every isogeny class contains a point lifting to a special point. The paper also corrects §1.5 and (3.3.9) of Kisin's 2010 integral-models paper. Complete (cc-442dc5): every numbered statement is an item, every missing item is routed exactly once, and five findings are recorded, four of them the printed corrections to [Ki 2] and Moonen. Not formalised.

items.statement: Changing the Tate lattice of an adapted lift by g gives a special Dieudonné lattice g0D with tildeκ(g0)=tildeκ(g). The frame representing g0 lies in G(L), not necessarily G(OL).

items.name: Central quotient compatible specialized frame
items.statement: Under the Galois-image condition of Lemma1.2.19, choose the specialized frame so that its image under the stated central quotient agrees with the original Tate frame modulo integral points.

items.name: Frobenius change of relative-position convention
items.statement: The map g↦σ^−1(b^−1g) identifies the X_{σ(μ)^−1}(b) and X_{μ^−1}(b) descriptions used for the contravariant crystal.

items.name: Liftable lattice classes meet every component
items.statement: In the HN-indecomposable case of Proposition1.2.21, the rational Tate-lattice cosets of the chosen adapted lift meet every frame component of the relevant ADLV.

items.name: Levi-adapted lift meets all components
items.statement: For the general minuscule datum, choose the Levi-adapted lift of Proposition1.2.23 so that its liftable Tate-lattice image meets every relevant connected component.

items.name: Hyperspecial Hodge-type integral model
items.statement: For a Hodge-type Shimura datum at p>2 with a reductive integral symplectic embedding and hyperspecial Kp, take the normalization of its closure in the sufficiently small Siegel good-level model; retain the universal abelian scheme and tensor system.

api.name: Kisin17.S01.mk
api.statement: Specify the embedding, level, closure and normalization.

api.name: Kisin17.S01.characterisation
api.statement: Its formal local models carry the fixed integral tensor system.

api.name: Kisin17.S01.map
api.statement: Away-p level maps and reflex-base changes act on the tower.

uses.how: Away-p level maps and reflex-base changes act on the tower.

items.name: Integral realizations of absolute Hodge tensors
items.statement: The absolute Hodge tensors defining the Hodge embedding have compatible integral étale, de Rham and crystalline realizations at the admitted integral points, with the inverse Hodge-cocharacter convention.

items.name: Tensor description of formal branches
items.statement: The adapted formally smooth deformation space identifies the appropriate formal component of the normalization; branches above a closure point agree exactly when their crystalline tensors agree.

items.name: Frobenius action on the isogeny parameter
items.statement: Let r be the local reflex residue degree and b the crystalline Frobenius matrix. Define Φ_r(g)=bσ(b)…σ^{r−1}(b)σ^r(g) on the prescribed ADLV cosets.

api.name: Kisin17.S04.mk
api.statement: Construct the norm product in its ordered noncommutative form.

api.name: Kisin17.S04.characterisation
api.statement: It preserves the relative-position condition for the chosen μ and r.

api.name: Kisin17.S04.map
api.statement: Powers and compatible central/Hecke actions commute as stated.

uses.how: Powers and compatible central/Hecke actions commute as stated.

items.name: Isogeny map into the integral Hodge model
items.statement: For x in the special fiber, the unique map ι_x from the crystalline-tensor ADLV to the Hodge integral model realizes the corresponding p-divisible lattice modification and preserves its tensors.

items.name: A framed lattice family acquires an integral connection
items.statement: For the smooth framed family in Lemma1.4.6, sufficiently many Frobenius pullbacks make the transformed connection preserve the lattice; the height-one crystal then comes from a p-divisible group with the stated filtration.

items.name: A family through one Hodge point factors through Hodge type
items.statement: The family of modified abelian varieties in Proposition1.4.9 factors through the Hodge integral model if one point does, using the adapted deformation rings, horizontal tensors and the stated connected smooth frame.

items.name: All ADLV components satisfy the Hodge condition
items.statement: The good locus for the isogeny map is a union of frame components; the liftable characteristic-zero quasi-isogenies meet every component, so the locus is the whole ADLV.

items.name: Characteristic-zero specialization diagram
items.statement: The generic Tate-lattice isogeny map specializes to the crystalline ADLV isogeny map in the diagram of Corollary1.4.12.

items.name: Isogeny map equivariance
items.statement: The isogeny map commutes with geometric reflex Frobenius, Z_G(Qp) and the away-p Hecke action.

items.name: Tensor-preserving geometric isogeny class
items.statement: The class of x is the image of ι_x with all away-p levels. Equivalently it consists of points linked by a quasi-isogeny preserving weak polarization, every away-p étale tensor and every crystalline tensor.

api.name: Kisin17.S11.mk
api.statement: Construct the class as an image and its quasi-isogeny witnesses.

api.name: Kisin17.S11.characterisation
api.statement: Both crystalline and away-p tensor conditions are required.

api.name: Kisin17.S11.map
api.statement: Transport along a tensor-preserving quasi-isogeny identifies the parameterizations.

uses.how: Transport along a tensor-preserving quasi-isogeny identifies the parameterizations.

items.name: Fixed-field and geometric tensor automorphism groups
items.statement: For x over finite k, I_/k is its rational tensor-preserving quasi-automorphism group; I is the group after geometric endomorphisms stabilize. Define I_ell/k and I_ell using Frobenius centralizers, and I_p/k via δσ; stabilized groups use sufficiently divisible extensions.

api.name: Kisin17.S12.mk
api.statement: Record the rational group and all realization homomorphisms.

api.name: Kisin17.S12.characterisation
api.statement: At p, an automorphism i acts on the contravariant realization as D(i^−1).

api.name: Kisin17.S12.map
api.statement: Finite-field extension maps compare fixed-field groups with stabilized groups.

uses.where: §§2.1.1–2.1.2; consumers PAPER-KISIN-17/S13, PAPER-KISIN-17/S14, PAPER-KISIN-17/S19, PAPER-KISIN-17/K01, PAPER-KISIN-17/K02
uses.how: Finite-field extension maps compare fixed-field groups with stabilized groups.

items.name: Rational double quotient injects into the Shimura tower
items.statement: The map ι_x induces an injection I(Q)\(X_ν(δ)×G(Af^p)) into the special-fiber tower, with image the isogeny class.

items.name: Finite-field adelic class-set injection
items.statement: For the specified compact stabilizers H^p,H_p, the finite-field adelic I_/k class set injects into the finite-level k-points; neat level removes the residual automorphism ambiguity.

items.name: Full-rank tensor automorphism group
items.statement: There is an auxiliary split prime ell with I_Qell≃I_ell; hence rank I=rank G.

items.name: A maximal centralizer torus admits the required cocharacter
items.statement: Every maximal Qp-torus T⊂I_p admits μ_T conjugate to μ with Galois average μ_T-bar=ν_δ^−1.

items.name: Special point in every Hodge-type isogeny class
items.statement: Every tensor-preserving geometric isogeny class of the hyperspecial Hodge-type special fiber at p>2 contains the reduction of a special point.

items.name: Special lift with prescribed torus filtration
items.statement: For maximal global T⊂I and μ_T conjugate to μ with average ν_δ^−1, a point in the isogeny class admits a special lift with T-action and the associated admissible filtration. Fix the inverse-filtration dictionary of Lemma2.2.2 and its proof; author Corollary2.2.5 writes μ_T for that filtration.

items.name: Common rational Frobenius representative
items.statement: There is γ0∈G(Q) conjugate to γ_ell in G(Qell) for every ell≠p, stably conjugate to γ_p at p, and elliptic over R.

items.name: All-prime tensor automorphism comparison
items.statement: For every finite prime, including p, I_Qell≃I_ell and (I_/k)_Qell≃I_ell/k via the realization maps.

items.name: Global automorphism group as an inner form
items.statement: After increasing the finite field so the Frobenius centralizer has stabilized, I is an inner form of I0=C_G(γ0), and its local realization isomorphisms agree with that inner twisting up to inner automorphisms.

items.name: Galois gerb with algebraic kernel
items.statement: For a characteristic-zero Galois extension k′/k, a gerb is a topological extension 1→H(k′)→Q→Gal(k′/k)→1, with discrete kernel, algebraic semilinear conjugation, and a continuous section over a finite-index Galois subgroup giving the required descent and semidirect-product chart.

api.name: Kisin17.C01.mk
api.statement: Construct the extension, algebraic kernel and finite-index section.

api.name: Kisin17.C01.characterisation
api.statement: Distinguish the original topology from the auxiliary Zariski topology.

api.name: Kisin17.C01.map
api.statement: Pullback in the Galois group and pushout of the kernel implement change of splitting field.

uses.how: Pullback in the Galois group and pushout of the kernel implement change of splitting field.

items.name: Morphisms and conjugacy of Galois gerbs
items.statement: A gerb morphism is continuous over the Galois group and algebraic on the kernel. Conjugacy is by target-kernel points. For pro-gerbs keep the compatible finite-stage conjugacy data.

api.name: Kisin17.C02.mk
api.statement: Construct a morphism with its kernel homomorphism.

api.name: Kisin17.C02.characterisation
api.statement: Conjugation gives an isomorphism relation with specified witnesses.

api.name: Kisin17.C02.map
api.statement: Compose morphisms and transport conjugators across kernel maps.

uses.how: Compose morphisms and transport conjugators across kernel maps.

items.name: Gerb isomorphism scheme and automorphism group
items.statement: For morphisms f1,f2 into the neutral gerb of G, the functor of kernel-point conjugators is the descended k-scheme Isom(f1,f2); I_f=Isom(f,f) is its automorphism group.

api.name: Kisin17.C03.mk
api.statement: Construct the conjugator equations after the splitting field.

api.name: Kisin17.C03.characterisation
api.statement: A point is exactly a conjugation between the specified morphisms.

api.name: Kisin17.C03.map
api.statement: Composition of isomorphisms and change of target are compatible with descent.

uses.how: Composition of isomorphisms and change of target are compatible with descent.

items.name: Descent of the kernel-image centralizer
items.statement: I_f becomes the centralizer of f_alg(H) after scalar extension to k′, with descent action induced by f of a continuous section. Its cocycle defect acts trivially on that centralizer.

items.name: Gerb morphisms with fixed algebraic restriction
items.statement: Morphisms f′ with exactly the same algebraic restriction as f correspond to continuous Z1(Gal(k′/k),I_f(k′)); f′ is conjugate to f exactly when its class in the twisted H1 is trivial.

items.name: Crossed module and quotient groupoid
items.statement: A homomorphism ∂:F→H with H-action on F satisfies equivariance and the Peiffer identity. Its quotient groupoid H/F has objects H and arrows f:h1→h2 when h2=∂(f)h1, with the induced strict monoidal structure.

api.name: Kisin17.C05.mk
api.statement: Construct the boundary, action and both identities, then objects and arrows.

api.name: Kisin17.C05.characterisation
api.statement: The monoidal product uses the action in its arrow formula.

api.name: Kisin17.C05.map
api.statement: A crossed-module morphism gives a strict monoidal quotient functor.

uses.how: A crossed-module morphism gives a strict monoidal quotient functor.

items.name: Monoidal isomorphism and conjugacy data
items.statement: For strict monoidal functors, retain natural isomorphisms respecting tensor and unit, conjugacy by a target group element, and the composite relation conjugate-isomorphism.

api.name: Kisin17.C06.mk
api.statement: Construct a monoidal natural isomorphism with its coherence.

api.name: Kisin17.C06.characterisation
api.statement: Conjugacy and natural isomorphism are distinct relations before a comparison theorem.

api.name: Kisin17.C06.map
api.statement: Whisker and compose isomorphisms with strict monoidal functors.

uses.how: Whisker and compose isomorphisms with strict monoidal functors.

items.name: Simply connected quotient as a Picard groupoid
items.statement: For connected reductive G over characteristic zero, the canonical G-action on Gsc from the lifted commutator gives Gsc→G a crossed module and the quotient G/Gsc a Picard groupoid; retain its neutral-gerb analogue.

api.name: Kisin17.C07.mk
api.statement: Construct the canonical action and quotient with its commutativity data.

api.name: Kisin17.C07.characterisation
api.statement: Its automorphism kernel and object-class quotient are both retained.

api.name: Kisin17.C07.map
api.statement: A reductive group map induces compatible quotient-category and gerb maps.

uses.where: §3.2.2; Borovoi3.7.1; consumers PAPER-KISIN-17/C08, PAPER-KISIN-17/C12, PAPER-KISIN-17/H05, PAPER-KISIN-17/R01, PAPER-KISIN-17/R08
uses.how: A reductive group map induces compatible quotient-category and gerb maps.

items.name: Conjugacy is redundant in the Picard quotient
items.statement: For functors into G/Gsc over the algebraic closure, conjugate-isomorphic is equivalent to isomorphic.

items.name: Cocharacters of the Picard quotient
items.statement: Algebraically induced monoidal cocharacters of G/Gsc modulo isomorphism are naturally π1(G).

items.name: Picard-stack cocharacters lift to G
items.statement: Every morphism of Picard stacks Gm→G/Gsc over the algebraic closure lifts to G, and its equivalence class is the cocharacter class of C09.

items.name: Two-fiber product of categories
items.statement: For F1:C1→C and F2:C2→C, objects are (c1,c2,α:F1(c1)≃F2(c2)); arrows are pairs making the comparison square commute. Strict monoidal structures induce the compatible monoidal two-fiber product.

api.name: Kisin17.C11.mk
api.statement: Construct the objects, invertible comparison and arrow squares.

api.name: Kisin17.C11.characterisation
api.statement: A functor into it is a pair of functors with an invertible comparison; likewise monoidally.

api.name: Kisin17.C11.map
api.statement: Compatible maps of the diagram induce functors of two-fiber products.

uses.how: Compatible maps of the diagram induce functors of two-fiber products.

items.name: Reconstruction from adjoint and Picard quotient
items.statement: G(Qbar) is equivalent, as a monoidal category, to Gad(Qbar)×_{Gad/Gsc}(G/Gsc)(Qbar).

items.name: Neutral gerb reconstruction
items.statement: The analogous two-fiber-product equivalence reconstructs the neutral gerb of G from its adjoint gerb and its G/Gsc quotient gerb.

items.name: Continuous cohomology of a crossed module
items.statement: For a profinite Δ continuously acting on discrete crossed-module groups F→H, construct H^−1,H0,H1 from the cocycle formulas and gauge relations. H0 is a group; H1 is initially a pointed set.

api.name: Kisin17.H02.mk
api.statement: Specify continuous cocycles in each degree and the gauge action.

api.name: Kisin17.H02.characterisation
api.statement: Compare F=1 with ordinary H0,H1 and H=1 with shifted abelian cohomology.

api.name: Kisin17.H02.map
api.statement: Restriction, coefficient maps and inflation preserve the cocycle formulas.

uses.how: Restriction, coefficient maps and inflation preserve the cocycle formulas.

items.name: Crossed-module quasi-isomorphism invariance
items.statement: A morphism of crossed modules inducing isomorphisms on kernel and cokernel induces bijections on the stated continuous H^−1,H0,H1.

items.name: Crossed-module low-degree exact sequence
items.statement: The exact sequence runs from H^−1(F→H) through H0(F),H0(H),H0(F→H),H1(F),H1(H),H1(F→H), with pointed-set exactness at nonabelian terms.

items.name: Reductive abelianized cohomology
items.statement: For connected reductive G, the central and maximal-torus complexes Z(Gsc)→ZG and Tsc→T are quasi-isomorphic to Gsc→G. Transport their abelian hypercohomology to give canonical functorial abelian H^i(Gsc→G).
items.locator: Borovoi3.8.1–3.8.2, correcting the scope of Kisin3.2.7(4)

items.name: Global-real abelianization square
items.statement: For connected reductive H/Q, the square H1(Q,H)→H1(Q,Hsc→H) over H1(R,H)→H1(R,Hsc→H) is cartesian, and all four arrows are surjective.

items.name: Universal quasi-motivic torus at a finite level
items.statement: For finite Galois L/Q, write L(v)=L∩Qv. Define Q_L=(Res_{L(∞)/Q}Gm×Res_{L(p)/Q}Gm)/Gm diagonally, with its two local cocharacters and ψ_L given by p inclusion times inverse infinity inclusion into Res_{L/Q}Gm.

api.name: Kisin17.Q01.mk
api.statement: Construct the quotient torus and local cocharacters.

api.name: Kisin17.Q01.characterisation
api.statement: Its cocharacter universal property is the weighted trace relation in Lemma3.1.4.

api.name: Kisin17.Q01.map
api.statement: The transition is the norm raised to the local extension degree.

uses.how: The transition is the norm raised to the local extension degree.

items.name: Universal weighted local cocharacter relation
items.statement: (Q_L,ν∞,νp) is initial among L-split Q-tori with local cocharacters satisfying Σ_{v=p,∞}[L_v:Q_v]^−1 tr_{L/Q}(ν_v)=0.

items.name: Quasi-motivic protorus and rational p-cocharacter
items.statement: Take Q=lim_L Q_L with the specified norm-power transitions; D=lim_{n|n′}Gm has transition x↦x^{n′/n}, n>0. Construct ν∞:Gm_R→Q_R and νp:D→Q_Qp using the local degree rescalings.

api.name: Kisin17.Q03.mk
api.statement: Construct the inverse systems and compatible local maps.

api.name: Kisin17.Q03.characterisation
api.statement: The rational p-cocharacter has its degree denominator recorded.

api.name: Kisin17.Q03.map
api.statement: Finite Galois extension changes commute with ψ:Q→lim Res Gm.

uses.how: Finite Galois extension changes commute with ψ:Q→lim Res Gm.

items.name: Local fundamental-class gerbs
items.statement: At v≠p,∞ use Gal(Qbarv/Qv); at infinity use the fundamental extension by C×; at p use the inverse system of local fundamental-class extensions, with kernel D and its unramified presentation.

api.name: Kisin17.Q04.mk
api.statement: Construct the local extensions and their compatible transition maps.

api.name: Kisin17.Q04.characterisation
api.statement: Identify the induced gerb of the unramified presentation with Gp.

api.name: Kisin17.Q04.map
api.statement: Localization and passage to a larger finite splitting field preserve the fundamental class.

uses.how: Localization and passage to a larger finite splitting field preserve the fundamental class.

items.name: Quasi-motivic Galois gerb
items.statement: A pro-gerb Q with kernel the protorus Q has local morphisms ζ_v matching ν∞,νp, a Galois-compatible kernel identification, and integral local sections at almost all finite primes after each finite torus pushout.

api.name: Kisin17.Q05.mk
api.statement: Construct the pro-gerb, local maps and almost-all integrality data.

api.name: Kisin17.Q05.characterisation
api.statement: Kernel identification is Galois compatible, as required by footnote14.

api.name: Kisin17.Q05.map
api.statement: A compatible isomorphism transports all local sections up to conjugacy.

uses.how: A compatible isomorphism transports all local sections up to conjugacy.

items.name: Existence and uniqueness of the quasi-motivic gerb
items.statement: A quasi-motivic gerb exists and is unique up to a gerb isomorphism respecting each local morphism up to conjugacy; that isomorphism is itself unique up to conjugacy.

items.name: Universal induced-torus gerb morphism
items.statement: The protorus map ψ_alg lifts to ψ:Q→G_{lim Res Gm}, uniquely up to conjugacy.

items.name: Gerb morphism attached to a torus cocharacter
items.statement: For T/Q and μ∈X_*(T) defined over finite Galois L, send Σ a_τ τ to Σ a_τ τ(μ) on cocharacters of Res_{L/Q}Gm, and compose ψ to obtain ψ_μ:Q→G_T.

api.name: Kisin17.Q08.mk
api.statement: Construct the group-ring cocharacter map.

api.name: Kisin17.Q08.characterisation
api.statement: Its p-composite is the local Galois average of μ; its infinity composite is −(μ+cμ).

api.name: Kisin17.Q08.map
api.statement: Torus maps and extension of L preserve the conjugacy class.

uses.how: Torus maps and extension of L preserve the conjugacy class.

items.name: Weil torus
items.statement: For a CM field L and q=p^m, take q-Weil numbers of an integral weight, units away from p and with the stated integral local norm valuations; quotient by roots of unity. The power transition systems define the stable finite-rank character lattice of P^L.

api.name: Kisin17.Q09.mk
api.statement: Specify weight, local valuation and root-of-unity quotient.

api.name: Kisin17.Q09.characterisation
api.statement: The local cocharacter pairing is the normalized logarithm of the local norm.

api.name: Kisin17.Q09.map
api.statement: CM-field extension and m-divisibility transport characters by the specified power map.

uses.how: CM-field extension and m-divisibility transport characters by the specified power map.

items.name: Universal Weil-torus trace relation
items.statement: The Weil torus is initial among the split tori with rational infinity and L(p)-defined p-cocharacters satisfying [L_p:Qp]^−1 tr_{L/L0}νp+ν∞=0; Q_L surjects onto P^L.

items.name: Distinguished Weil Frobenius elements
items.statement: For sufficiently divisible positive n choose δ_n∈P^L(Q), unique modulo torsion, with χ_π(δ_n)=π^{n/m} for q=p^m and m|n. Retain power and CM-extension compatibility.

api.name: Kisin17.Q11.mk
api.statement: Construct δ_n with the character evaluation equations.

api.name: Kisin17.Q11.characterisation
api.statement: Its ambiguity is exactly the stated torsion ambiguity.

api.name: Kisin17.Q11.map
api.statement: For n|n′ transport by the n′/n power modulo torsion.

uses.how: For n|n′ transport by the n′/n power modulo torsion.

items.name: Motivic pro-gerb as a pushout
items.statement: Set P=lim_L P^L with its rescaled ν∞,νp and push out the quasi-motivic gerb Q along Q→P. This is the gerb used here, without asserting a category of actual motives realizing it.

api.name: Kisin17.Q12.mk
api.statement: Construct the inverse system and pushout gerb.

api.name: Kisin17.Q12.characterisation
api.statement: The induced local cocharacters agree with those of Q.

api.name: Kisin17.Q12.map
api.statement: Finite-level pushouts commute with the compatible CM transitions.

uses.how: Finite-level pushouts commute with the compatible CM transitions.

items.name: Serre condition on a torus cocharacter
items.statement: For complex conjugation c, require (τ−1)(c+1)η=(c+1)(τ−1)η=0 for every τ. A Serre torus satisfies this for all cocharacters; it is isogenous to a Q-split torus times a real-compact torus.

api.name: Kisin17.Q13.mk
api.statement: Construct the predicate with both Galois identities.

api.name: Kisin17.Q13.characterisation
api.statement: Export the split-times-compact isogeny characterization and CM splitting.

api.name: Kisin17.Q13.map
api.statement: Compatible torus maps preserve Serre cocharacters.

uses.how: Compatible torus maps preserve Serre cocharacters.

items.name: Refined abelianization of a gerb morphism
items.statement: Compose a morphism Q→G_G with G_G→G_G/Gsc; attach ψ_mu^ref through the group-ring construction in the quotient monoidal category. This retains the full π1(G) class.

api.name: Kisin17.R01.mk
api.statement: Construct the quotient functor and its μ-induced reference map.

api.name: Kisin17.R01.characterisation
api.statement: Conjugate μ give isomorphic refined functors.

api.name: Kisin17.R01.map
api.statement: Reductive group maps transport the refined quotient and its reference map.

uses.how: Reductive group maps transport the refined quotient and its reference map.

items.name: Local gerb isogeny parameter set
items.statement: For θ:Gp→G_G(p), Xp(θ) consists of g modulo G(Zp^ur) such that Int(g^−1)θ descends to the unramified gerb and sends d_σ to b_g⋊σ with b_g∈G(Zp^ur)p^{−μ}G(Zp^ur).

api.name: Kisin17.R02.mk
api.statement: Construct the coset with an actual unramified-descent witness.

api.name: Kisin17.R02.characterisation
api.statement: Descent is equivalent to the prescribed identity on the inertia subgroup.

api.name: Kisin17.R02.map
api.statement: The reflex Frobenius sends g to g b_g…σ^{r−1}(b_g).

uses.how: The reflex Frobenius sends g to g b_g…σ^{r−1}(b_g).

items.name: Local gerb parameter equals an ADLV
items.statement: After choosing g0 giving an unramified presentation, g↦g0g identifies X_{−μ}(b_g0) with Xp(θ), compatibly with Frobenius.

items.name: Admissible gerb morphism
items.statement: For a hyperspecial unramified Shimura datum, φ:Q→G_G is admissible when its refined abelianization is conjugate-isomorphic to ψ_mu^ref, its local maps at v≠p are conjugate to ξ_v, and Xp(φ) is nonempty. At infinity ξ∞ uses the weight and μ_h(−1).

api.name: Kisin17.R04.mk
api.statement: Construct witnesses for all three admissibility conditions.

api.name: Kisin17.R04.characterisation
api.statement: Use B(G,−μ) for the p-nonemptiness test, retaining κ torsion.

api.name: Kisin17.R04.map
api.statement: Compatible Shimura maps carry the local comparison data.

uses.how: Compatible Shimura maps carry the local comparison data.

items.name: Adelic point parameter and its twisted quotient
items.statement: For admissible φ, X^p is the restricted-product torsor of local conjugators, X=Xp×X^p, and S_tau(φ)=lim_{K^p}I_phi(Q)\X/K^p with the rational I-action conjugated by tau∈I_phi^ad(Af).

api.name: Kisin17.R05.mk
api.statement: Construct the restricted-product torsor and finite-level double quotients.

api.name: Kisin17.R05.characterisation
api.statement: At tau=1 recover S(φ); retain the actual action in every quotient.

api.name: Kisin17.R05.map
api.statement: ZG(Qp), away-p Hecke and Frobenius commute and descend to the tower.

uses.how: ZG(Qp), away-p Hecke and Frobenius commute and descend to the tower.

items.name: Refined compatibility implies local quotient compatibility
items.statement: Condition1 of admissibility implies the refined local quotient is conjugate-isomorphic to ξ_v for every v≠p.

items.name: Admissibility lifts the adjoint p-condition
items.statement: If φ satisfies refined abelianization and Xp(φad) is nonempty, then Xp(φ) is nonempty.

items.name: Positive rational-adjoint lifting group
items.statement: G(Qbar)^natural+ is the preimage of Gad(Q)^+; its quotient by G(Q)^+ is identified with central cocycles whose class is real-trivial and comes from H1(Q,ZGsc).

api.name: Kisin17.R08.mk
api.statement: Construct the preimage and the cocycle g^−1τ(g).

api.name: Kisin17.R08.characterisation
api.statement: The quotient corresponds to actual central cocycles, with the stated condition on their classes.

api.name: Kisin17.R08.map
api.statement: Central group maps transport positivity and the cocycle class.

uses.how: Central group maps transport positivity and the cocycle class.

items.name: Admissible lifts form a nonempty torsor
items.statement: For admissible φ0 into Gad, admissible lifts into G form a torsor under G(Qbar)^natural+/G(Q)^+; the lifts conjugate to one fixed φ form an I_phi0(Qbar)^natural/I_phi(Q)-torsor.

items.name: Parameter set with fixed adjoint morphism
items.statement: S_tau(G,φ0) is the tower quotient of the disjoint union of X(φ) over all admissible lifts of φ0 by I_phi0(Qbar)^natural, using the tau-conjugated action.

api.name: Kisin17.R10.mk
api.statement: Construct the disjoint union and rational-adjoint action.

api.name: Kisin17.R10.characterisation
api.statement: Its decomposition into lift conjugacy classes is the bijection of Corollary3.4.16.

api.name: Kisin17.R10.map
api.statement: Hecke, center and Frobenius actions agree with each summand.

uses.how: Hecke, center and Frobenius actions agree with each summand.

items.name: Special torus morphisms are admissible
items.statement: If i:T→G and h_T define a toric Shimura subdatum, i∘ψ_mu_hT is admissible.

items.name: Special admissible morphism
items.statement: An admissible morphism is special if it is conjugate to i∘ψ_mu_hT for some toric Shimura subdatum (T,h_T,i).

api.name: Kisin17.R12.mk
api.statement: Construct the torus, Shimura map and conjugator.

api.name: Kisin17.R12.characterisation
api.statement: Specialness concerns a morphism conjugacy class, not a chosen reduction point.

api.name: Kisin17.R12.map
api.statement: Composition with a compatible Shimura map preserves specialness.

uses.how: Composition with a compatible Shimura map preserves specialness.

items.name: Specialness detected on the adjoint quotient
items.statement: An admissible φ is special iff φad is special.

items.name: All admissible morphisms are special
items.statement: Every admissible morphism into a Shimura datum is special, in the hypotheses of §3.

items.name: Factorization through the motivic gerb
items.statement: If ZG° splits over a CM field and the weight is rational, every admissible φ factors through P; in particular this holds when ZG° satisfies the Serre condition.

items.name: Refined quotient local parameter sets
items.statement: For the refined functor φ, X^p uses pairs (g_ell,ε_ell) with monoidal local isomorphisms, modulo Gsc(Qbar adeles). Xp uses G(Qbarp)/(Gsc(Qp^ur)G(Zp^ur)), exact unramified descent, and tildeκ(b)=[−μ] before Frobenius coinvariants.

api.name: Kisin17.R16.mk
api.statement: Construct the pair data, twisted cocycles and their restricted integrality.

api.name: Kisin17.R16.characterisation
api.statement: A chosen functor isomorphism transports the set; its automorphisms can act nontrivially.

api.name: Kisin17.R16.map
api.statement: Right multiplication transports to the appropriate central-cocycle twist.

uses.how: Right multiplication transports to the appropriate central-cocycle twist.

items.name: Gerb connected-component torsor
items.statement: Form tildeπ(G,φ0) from the quotient local sets over all admissible lifts, then quotient by G(Qbar)^natural+ and take the away-p level limit. It is a torsor under π(G)=closure(G(Q)^+)\G(Af)/G(Zp).

api.name: Kisin17.R17.mk
api.statement: Construct the right actions and topological quotient.

api.name: Kisin17.R17.characterisation
api.statement: A chosen point identifies the torsor with π(G), using strong approximation and compact hyperspecial level.

api.name: Kisin17.R17.map
api.statement: Compatible Shimura maps preserve the torsor structure.

uses.how: Compatible Shimura maps preserve the torsor structure.

items.name: Canonical comparison for adjoint-conjugate morphisms
items.statement: If φad and φ′ad are conjugate, their π(G)-torsors are canonically isomorphic as in Corollary3.6.4. This identification need not be the tautological identity on coincident underlying sets.

items.name: Toric local parameter with connected Néron level
items.statement: For any Q-torus T and μ_T, use tildeκ_T:T(Qp^ur)→X_*(T)_I with kernel T°(Zp^ur), the connected Néron model. Define toric X and S=closure(T(Q))\X; for protori take the stated inverse systems.

api.name: Kisin17.R19.mk
api.statement: Construct the inertia-coinvariant p-condition and connected Néron level.

api.name: Kisin17.R19.characterisation
api.statement: The denominator is T°, not the whole Néron model.

api.name: Kisin17.R19.map
api.statement: Torus and protorus maps transport the parameter sets.

uses.how: Torus and protorus maps transport the parameter sets.

items.name: Canonical trivialization of the toric double quotient
items.statement: X(ψ_muT) is a T(Af)/T°(Zp)-torsor and S(ψ_muT) is canonically T(Q)^−\T(Af)/T°(Zp), functorially in (T,μ_T).

items.name: Integral Shimura datum category
items.statement: An object of SHp is a reductive G/Z_(p) with a Shimura datum on its generic fiber; morphisms are integral reductive maps inducing Shimura maps. Fix the adjoint datum and optionally X+ for the indicated subcategories.

api.name: Kisin17.R21.mk
api.statement: Construct the integral model, datum and morphisms.

api.name: Kisin17.R21.characterisation
api.statement: The hyperspecial subgroup is part of the integral object.

api.name: Kisin17.R21.map
api.statement: Identity and composition preserve the fixed-adjoint subcategory.

uses.how: Identity and composition preserve the fixed-adjoint subcategory.

items.name: Gerb components identify with Shimura components
items.statement: There is a unique system θ_G:π(G,φ0)≃π0(Sh_Kp(G,X)(C)), natural for fixed-adjoint integral Shimura maps and compatible with every special-torus reciprocity diagram.

items.name: Semidirect quotient for compatible actions
items.statement: If Δ acts on H and Γ⊂H, with equivariant Γ→Δ acting by conjugation on H, define H*ΓΔ=(H⋊Δ)/{(γ,φ(γ)^−1)}. This is the source’s semidirect quotient, not an arbitrary free amalgamated product.

api.name: Kisin17.R23.mk
api.statement: Construct the normal graph subgroup and quotient.

api.name: Kisin17.R23.characterisation
api.statement: Compatible H- and Δ-actions agreeing on Γ descend uniquely.

api.name: Kisin17.R23.map
api.statement: Maps preserving the action diagram induce quotient homomorphisms.

uses.how: Maps preserving the action diagram induce quotient homomorphisms.

items.name: Arithmetic action group and its component kernel
items.statement: A(G)=G(Af^p)*_{G(Z_(p))^+}Gad(Z_(p))^+, and A(G)° uses the closure of G(Z_(p))^+ in G(Af^p). It acts on S_tau(G,φ0) and projects to π(G).

api.name: Kisin17.R24.mk
api.statement: Construct the integral positive adjoint action and quotient.

api.name: Kisin17.R24.characterisation
api.statement: Identify A° as the stabilizer of a component.

api.name: Kisin17.R24.map
api.statement: Level maps and compatible integral Shimura maps intertwine the actions.

uses.where: Lemma3.7.2; §3.7.3; consumers PAPER-KISIN-17/R25, PAPER-KISIN-17/R26, PAPER-KISIN-17/R28, PAPER-KISIN-17/K05, PAPER-KISIN-17/E06
uses.how: Level maps and compatible integral Shimura maps intertwine the actions.

items.name: Surjective equivariant component projection
items.statement: The local quotient maps induce c_G:S_tau(G,φ0)→π(G,φ0), surjective and A(G)-equivariant for every admitted tau.

items.name: Central equivariance follows from Hecke equivariance
items.statement: For the unramified center in §3.7.10, ZG(Qp)=ZG(Zp)ZG(Q), with the finite component quotient treated by Lang and finite flatness. Hence the indicated bijection’s ZG(Qp)-equivariance follows from away-p equivariance and trivial diagonal rational action.

items.name: Connected gerb parameter fiber
items.statement: Fix X+ in the adjoint datum, let y be its preimage under θ_G, and set S_tau(G,φ0)^+=c_G^−1(y). Retain the ambient group action and chosen component.

api.name: Kisin17.R27.mk
api.statement: Construct the chosen fiber with its inclusion.

api.name: Kisin17.R27.characterisation
api.statement: Its stabilizer is the arithmetic Frobenius extension R29.

api.name: Kisin17.R27.map
api.statement: Derived-isomorphism maps identify the fibers in R28.

uses.how: Derived-isomorphism maps identify the fibers in R28.

items.name: Connected fiber invariant under a derived isomorphism
items.statement: A surjective map of integral reductive Shimura data inducing an isomorphism on derived groups induces a bijection on S_tau^+.

items.name: Arithmetic Frobenius stabilizer extension
items.statement: E_p^r is the stabilizer of S_tau^+ in A(G)×〈Φ_r〉. It is an extension of 〈Φ_r〉 by A°, determined by derived integral G, X+ and r, independently of φ0 and tau.

api.name: Kisin17.R29.mk
api.statement: Construct the stabilizer and its exact-sequence maps.

api.name: Kisin17.R29.characterisation
api.statement: An element (h,Φ^n) stabilizes iff its component equals N_{Qpr/Qp}([−μ])^−n.

api.name: Kisin17.R29.map
api.statement: Compatible derived isomorphisms transport the extension.

uses.how: Compatible derived isomorphisms transport the extension.

items.name: Reconstruction from the connected parameter fiber
items.statement: There is an A(G)×〈Φ〉-equivariant bijection S_tau(G,φ0)≃[A(G)×S_tau(Gder,φ0)^+]/A°, with the extension action defined by the semidirect-quotient construction.

items.name: Induced central torus quotient of parameters
items.statement: For a surjective integral reductive map with induced central torus kernel Z, S_tau(G2,φ0)≃S_tau(G,φ0)/Z(Af^p); the connected fibers and Frobenius extensions are induced along A(G)°→A(G2)°.

items.name: Central derived isogeny comparison
items.statement: For an integral central isogeny Gder→G2der with the same adjoint Shimura datum and r′ divisible by both local reflex degrees, S_tau(G2,φ0)≃[A(G2)×S_tau(Gder,φ0)^+]/A(G)°, equivariantly for A(G2)×〈Φ_r′〉; retain the corresponding extension and connected-fiber identifications.

items.name: Twist of a representation by a torsor
items.statement: For an affine Q-group Z, right Z-torsor P and Q-representation W, define W^P=(W⊗Q O(P))^Z using (zf)(x)=f(xz) on functions and the diagonal action.

api.name: Kisin17.T01.mk
api.statement: Construct the invariant module and its descent datum.

api.name: Kisin17.T01.characterisation
api.statement: After extension to O(P), W^P is canonically W.

api.name: Kisin17.T01.map
api.statement: Equivariant linear maps induce maps on twists, respecting identity and composition.

uses.how: Equivariant linear maps induce maps on twists, respecting identity and composition.

items.name: Exact tensor and dual compatibility of twisting
items.statement: The twist functor is exact and respects tensor products and duals; its comparison after O(P) is an isomorphism.

items.name: Galois cocycle of a twist frame
items.statement: For ω∈P(F), F/Q finite Galois, the evaluation frame θ_ω satisfies τθ_ωτ^−1=c_ω(τ)^−1 θ_ω with c_ω(τ)=ω^−1τ(ω).

items.name: Tensor isomorphisms of a twisted representation
items.statement: For finite free R-module W with Z-fixed tensors defining G_R, the tensor-isomorphism scheme W^P→W is the induced torsor (P_R×G_R)/Z with the stated inverse left action on G_R.

items.name: Twist of an abelian scheme up to isogeny
items.statement: For an abelian S-scheme A up to isogeny with affine Q-group Z action and Z-torsor P, the functor (A(T)⊗O(P))^Z is represented by an abelian scheme A^P up to isogeny, with compatible dual and weak polarization.

api.name: Kisin17.T05.mk
api.statement: Construct the descended object in the isogeny category.

api.name: Kisin17.T05.characterisation
api.statement: The O(P)-comparison identifies its dual and weak polarization.

api.name: Kisin17.T05.map
api.statement: Equivariant quasi-isogenies induce quasi-isogenies of twists.

uses.how: Equivariant quasi-isogenies induce quasi-isogenies of twists.

items.name: Exact additive realizations commute with twisting
items.statement: Any exact additive Q-linear realization of abelian schemes up to isogeny satisfies H(A^P)≃H(A)^P canonically.

items.name: Twisted adelic level structure
items.statement: For compact K in the commutant of Z, represent P as a GL(V)/Z fiber at ω; the twisted level uses V→V^P via ω^−1 and lands in the level K_ω=ωKω^−1 on A^P. Over a Z_(p)-base use only the away-p Tate module.

api.name: Kisin17.T07.mk
api.statement: Construct the sheaf of Z-compatible level isomorphisms.

api.name: Kisin17.T07.characterisation
api.statement: Changing a lift of ω does not change the resulting level section.

api.name: Kisin17.T07.map
api.statement: Level refinement and equivariant maps commute with twisting.

uses.how: Level refinement and equivariant maps commute with twisting.

items.name: Shimura subdatum twisted by a rational quotient point
items.statement: For G′⊂G and ω∈(G/ZG′)(Q), conjugate G′ by a lift of ω and descend. For Shimura data require the obstruction to vanish in H1(R,K∞), giving (G′_ω,X′_ω) and the analytic map i_ω.

api.name: Kisin17.T08.mk
api.statement: Construct the descended subgroup and real admissibility witness.

api.name: Kisin17.T08.characterisation
api.statement: Conjugation is independent of the lift because the discrepancy centralizes G′.

api.name: Kisin17.T08.map
api.statement: Compatible quotient points and level changes induce the corresponding Shimura maps.

uses.how: Compatible quotient points and level changes induce the corresponding Shimura maps.

items.name: Center compatibility of the Shimura level
items.statement: The adelic level structure of the abelian scheme on a Shimura subdatum commutes with the action of its center.

items.name: Moduli and analytic twisting coincide
items.statement: The abelian torsor twist with weak polarization and twisted level factors through the prescribed Shimura subvariety and agrees with i_ω on complex points. Its Betti Hodge tensors are the transported tensors.

items.name: Integral twist frame preserves the p-lattice
items.statement: For ω∈Gad(Z_(p))^+ and a lift in G(O_F,(p)), the twist comparison after coefficient extension is an isomorphism up to prime-to-p isogeny.

items.name: Kottwitz triple at a finite level
items.statement: For r>0 and k=Fp^r, a triple (γ0,γ^p,δ) has γ0∈G(Q) up to geometric conjugacy, γ^p∈G(Af^p), and δ∈G(Frac W(k)) up to integral σ-conjugacy. Match γ0 stably with γ_ell and N_rδ and require real ellipticity and the global inner-form condition K02.

api.name: Kisin17.K01.mk
api.statement: Construct the level, representatives, local matches and ellipticity.

api.name: Kisin17.K01.characterisation
api.statement: Power extension sends γ0,γ_ell to their mth powers and base-extends δ to level rm.

api.name: Kisin17.K01.map
api.statement: Conjugators and finite-field extension transport all local centralizer data.

uses.how: Conjugators and finite-field extension transport all local centralizer data.

items.name: Global inner twisting attached to a triple
items.statement: For the stabilized centralizer I0 of a sufficiently divisible power of γ0, require an inner twisting I/Q, anisotropic modulo center at R, and inner-compatible identifications with each stabilized local I_ell, including the σ-centralizer at p.

api.name: Kisin17.K02.mk
api.statement: Specify I and its geometric inner twisting, not just local isomorphism classes.

api.name: Kisin17.K02.characterisation
api.statement: The adjoint Hasse principle gives uniqueness up to Iad(Q)-conjugacy.

api.name: Kisin17.K02.map
api.statement: Compatible local conjugators transport the prescribed inner-form data.

uses.how: Compatible local conjugators transport the prescribed inner-form data.

items.name: Refined Kottwitz triple and its parameter set
items.statement: A refinement adds an adelic inner-compatible isomorphism ι:I_Af≃I_p×I_Af^p. Define S(ktilde) from the rational I-action through ι on X_ν(δ)×G(Af^p), with the away-p level tower understood.

api.name: Kisin17.K03.mk
api.statement: Construct the adelic refinement with almost-all integral compatibility.

api.name: Kisin17.K03.characterisation
api.statement: Changing ι by an adjoint adele changes the rational action as in R05.

api.name: Kisin17.K03.map
api.statement: Transport along local conjugators gives the corresponding parameter-set bijection.

uses.where: §4.3.1, author p75; consumers PAPER-KISIN-17/K05, PAPER-KISIN-17/K06, PAPER-KISIN-17/K13, PAPER-KISIN-17/K21
uses.how: Transport along local conjugators gives the corresponding parameter-set bijection.

items.name: Equivalence of Kottwitz triples
items.statement: First identify finite-level triples along power extensions. The second equivalence relation compares representatives at a common level by adelic conjugacy away from p and rational σ-conjugacy at p; do not conflate it with integral σ-conjugacy of a fixed representative.

api.name: Kisin17.K04.mk
api.statement: Construct both relations and common-level witnesses.

api.name: Kisin17.K04.characterisation
api.statement: Refinement transport depends on the chosen local conjugators.

api.name: Kisin17.K04.map
api.statement: Composition and inversion of equivalence witnesses induce the parameter bijections.

uses.how: Composition and inversion of equivalence witnesses induce the parameter bijections.

items.name: Stabilizer arithmetic group of a refined triple
items.statement: Let Gad(Z_(p))^{+,I} be the positive integral adjoint points with trivial image under H1(Q,ZG)→H1(Q,I). Define A(G)^I from this subgroup and G(Af^p).

api.name: Kisin17.K05.mk
api.statement: Construct the cohomological kernel and semidirect quotient.

api.name: Kisin17.K05.characterisation
api.statement: A lift h has a matching i_h∈I(Qbar) with identical central cocycle.

api.name: Kisin17.K05.map
api.statement: The action on the parameter is g↦i_h^−1gh.

uses.how: The action on the parameter is g↦i_h^−1gh.

items.name: Well-defined commuting arithmetic action on triples
items.statement: The formula i_h^−1gh preserves X_ν(δ)×G(Af^p), is independent on the rational quotient of all choices, and defines an A(G)^I-action commuting with Frobenius and ZG(Qp).

items.name: Cohomological twist of a triple
items.statement: For β∈H1(Q,I) real-trivial and trivial in H1(Qell,G) for ell≠p, choose local trivializations. Set γ_ell^β=g_ell γ_ell g_ell^−1 and δ^β=g0 δ σ(g0)^−1 after enlarging the finite field to solve the p-torsor. Use the inner form I^β.

api.name: Kisin17.K07.mk
api.statement: Construct the local cocycles and descended Frobenius elements.

api.name: Kisin17.K07.characterisation
api.statement: The result is well-defined up to triple equivalence, independently of the cocycle representative.

api.name: Kisin17.K07.map
api.statement: Successive torsor twists compose through the corresponding inner forms.

uses.how: Successive torsor twists compose through the corresponding inner forms.

items.name: Criterion for a twist to preserve a triple
items.statement: K^β is equivalent to K iff β has trivial image in H1(Qell,I) for every finite prime, under the real-trivial hypothesis of K07.

items.name: Special Kottwitz triple from a toric datum
items.statement: For a toric Shimura subdatum with Serre torus, map the sufficiently divisible Weil Frobenius δ_n through ψ_mu and use the local gerb, with its completion correction, to produce γ0 and δ with N_nδ=γ0. Its image in G is a special triple.

api.name: Kisin17.K09.mk
api.statement: Construct the finite CM level and the norm-compatible p-element.

api.name: Kisin17.K09.characterisation
api.statement: Different auxiliary choices give equivalent triples.

api.name: Kisin17.K09.map
api.statement: Compatible toric Shimura maps carry the construction to G.

uses.how: Compatible toric Shimura maps carry the construction to G.

items.name: Reciprocity construction of the same toric triple
items.statement: Use N(μ):Res_{L/Q}Gm→T, a local uniformizer π and a sufficiently small compact H with T(Q)∩H=1. A power of N(μ)(π^−1) gives γ0′∈T(Q); a Lang correction gives δ′ with the matching norm.

api.name: Kisin17.K10.mk
api.statement: Construct the norm morphism and finite class-set power.

api.name: Kisin17.K10.characterisation
api.statement: The compact level and rational-point discreteness determine γ0′.

api.name: Kisin17.K10.map
api.statement: A divisible enlargement of the power preserves the triple class.

uses.how: A divisible enlargement of the power preserves the triple class.

items.name: Agreement of toric triple constructions
items.statement: For sufficiently divisible common n, γ0=γ0′ and δ,δ′ are σ-conjugate already over Qp^n; hence K09 and K10 yield equivalent triples.

items.name: Real-trivial reductive cohomology kernel
items.statement: For connected reductive H/Q, Sha∞(Q,H) is the kernel of localization to H1(R,H). Identify it with the corresponding abelianized kernel through Hsc→H and retain that canonical abelian group structure.

api.name: Kisin17.H07.mk
api.statement: Construct the localization kernel and its abelianized comparison.

api.name: Kisin17.H07.characterisation
api.statement: The group law is transported from the center complex.

api.name: Kisin17.H07.map
api.statement: Reductive group maps induce homomorphisms between these kernels.

uses.how: Reductive group maps induce homomorphisms between these kernels.

items.name: Inner-form invariance of the real-trivial kernel
items.statement: An inner twisting Q→Q′ induces a canonical isomorphism of Sha∞ kernels; embeddings of Q,Q′ into H conjugate under that twisting induce the same map to Sha∞(Q,H).

items.name: Real compact-adjoint cohomology kernel injectivity
items.statement: For connected reductive H′⊂H over R, with H_ad(R) compact and H′ containing the maximal real-split central torus, ker(H1(R,H′)→H1(R,H)) is trivial.

items.name: Finite cohomology classes lift through a common torus
items.statement: For connected reductive H over a number field and a finite subset of H1(K,H), there is a maximal K-torus whose H1 image contains the subset.

items.name: Global and everywhere-local obstruction groups
items.statement: Sha∞_G(Q,I)=ker(Sha∞(Q,I)≃Sha∞(Q,I0)→Sha∞(Q,G)); Sha_G(Q,I) is its kernel under localization to every finite H1(Qell,I). Retain the inner-twisting comparison and the two different kernels.

api.name: Kisin17.K12.mk
api.statement: Construct the inner-invariant map and both kernels.

api.name: Kisin17.K12.characterisation
api.statement: Membership in Sha_G includes all finite I-localizations and the real condition.

api.name: Kisin17.K12.map
api.statement: Inner-compatible maps transport classes and their localization witnesses.

uses.how: Inner-compatible maps transport classes and their localization witnesses.

items.name: Geometric class yields a refined triple
items.statement: The tensor isogeny class I_x has a well-defined triple-equivalence class K(I_x), and a chosen point x gives its natural refinement via the all-prime tensor automorphism identifications.

items.name: Twist of a geometric isogeny class
items.statement: For β∈Sha∞_G(Q,I), choose a maximal torus lifting β, a special lift with its T-action, and the torus torsor twist at an admissible rational quotient point; reduce it to define I_x^β.

api.name: Kisin17.K14.mk
api.statement: Construct the special lift, torsor and good-reduction comparison.

api.name: Kisin17.K14.characterisation
api.statement: The tensor quasi-isogeny scheme of the twist has I-torsor class β.

api.name: Kisin17.K14.map
api.statement: A change of auxiliary torus or representative is handled by the torsor comparison.

uses.how: A change of auxiliary torus or representative is handled by the torsor comparison.

items.name: Geometric twisting is independent and injective
items.statement: I_x^β depends only on β, and β↦I_x^β is injective on Sha∞_G(Q,I).

items.name: Geometric twisting commutes with triples
items.statement: K(I_x^β) is equivalent to K(I_x)^β.

items.name: Geometric fiber is an obstruction torsor
items.statement: The fiber over K(I_x) of tensor isogeny classes→triple equivalence classes is naturally a Sha_G(Q,I)-torsor.

items.name: Geometric summand stabilizer and parameterization
items.statement: A(G)^I is the stabilizer of I_x, and I_x≃S(Ktilde(x)) is Frobenius, ZG(Qp) and A(G)^I-equivariant, taking x to1.

items.name: Central twist of a geometric parameterization
items.statement: For β induced by h∈Gad(Q)^+, the twisted geometric class has the equivariant parameterization I_x^β≃S(Ktilde(x)^β) of Proposition4.4.17, independent of the lift of h.

items.name: Component formula for a central geometric twist
items.statement: If ZG is a torus, the parameterization K19 satisfies c_G(x′)=(h_tilde g_x′^−1)c_G(x). The connected-center condition permits a coefficient splitting field unramified at p.

items.name: Triple attached to an admissible morphism
items.statement: When ZG° satisfies the Serre condition, an admissible φ factors through P. For g∈X(φ), use δ_n, a completed correction c and sufficiently close finite-unramified c′ to obtain an integral σ-class δ and a refined triple Ktilde(g). Its triple-equivalence class depends only on φ.

api.name: Kisin17.K21.mk
api.statement: Construct the finite-level approximation preserving the integral lattice.

api.name: Kisin17.K21.characterisation
api.statement: Keep the integral correction y_phi in the parameter comparison.

api.name: Kisin17.K21.map
api.statement: Conjugating φ and changing g transports the refinement and preserves its triple class.

uses.how: Conjugating φ and changing g transports the refinement and preserves its triple class.

items.name: Gerb-to-triple local parameter bijection
items.statement: The map g′↦g^−1 y_phi g′ identifies X(φ) with X_ν(δ)×G(Af^p), bivariantly for I(Af) and Frobenius×G(Af^p).

items.name: Twisted gerb quotient matches a refined triple
items.statement: S_tau(φ)≃S(Ktilde(g,tau)), where the adelic refinement is conjugated by tau; the map is Frobenius and away-p Hecke equivariant.

items.name: Cohomological twists remain admissible
items.statement: For β∈Sha∞_G(Q,I_phi), φ^β is admissible, its conjugacy class depends injectively on β, and K(φ^β) is equivalent to K(φ)^β.

items.name: Admissible-morphism fiber is an obstruction torsor
items.statement: A nonempty fiber of admissible morphism conjugacy classes→triple equivalence classes is naturally a Sha_G(Q,I)-torsor.

items.name: Gerb summand stabilizer and full equivariance
items.statement: A(G)^I stabilizes S_tau(φ) inside S_tau(G,φ0), and K23 is also ZG(Qp) and A(G)^I-equivariant.

items.name: Central gerb twist and component formula
items.statement: For h∈Gad(Q)^+ and β its central cocycle, S_tau(φ^β)≃S(Ktilde(g,tau)^β) via g′↦h_tilde g^−1y_phi g′, equivariantly; its component is h_tilde g^−1g′ times c_G(g).

items.name: Geometric and gerb special data give the same triple
items.statement: For a toric Shimura datum, the class of its special reduction and the corresponding special gerb morphism have the same Kottwitz triple equivalence class.

items.name: Sigma-centralizer surjects onto invariant fundamental classes
items.statement: For b∈G(L) with G unramified, J_b(Qp)→π1(G)^Γ is surjective.

items.name: Match an adjoint orbit of geometric and gerb classes
items.statement: For Hodge type with connected torus center, the union I^0=∪_{h∈Gad(Q)^+}I^[h] admits a Frobenius, center and A(G)-equivariant bijection to S_tau(G,φ0) for some tau, commuting with c_G and θ_G and matching each central twist summand.

items.name: Refined Hodge-type point classification
items.statement: Under the §4.6 Hodge-type and connected-center hypotheses, the special-fiber tower is the disjoint union of S_tau(phi0)(G,φ0), equivariantly for Frobenius, center and A(G), and compatibly with its connected-component map.

items.name: Maximal Hodge-derived cover of an abelian-type datum
items.statement: For an adjoint abelian-type Shimura datum (H,Y), Hsharp→H is the central isogeny through which the derived group of every Hodge-type lift is a quotient. It has a Hodge-type realization with derived group Hsharp and torus center.

api.name: Kisin17.M05.mk
api.statement: Construct the permitted cover from the adjoint factors.

api.name: Kisin17.M05.characterisation
api.statement: Its universal quotient property is restricted to Hodge-type realizations.

api.name: Kisin17.M05.map
api.statement: Products and the compatible adjoint identifications transport the cover.

uses.how: Products and the compatible adjoint identifications transport the cover.

items.name: Unramified Hodge cover with the same local reflex field
items.statement: If H is quasi-split and unramified at p, choose M05 quasi-split unramified at p with E(G,X)_p=E(H,Y)_p and center a torus.

items.name: Twisted Langlands–Rapoport theorem for abelian type
items.statement: Let p>2 and (G2,X2) be of abelian type with hyperspecial K2,p. Its tower admits an integral canonical model over the local reflex integers, and its geometric special-fiber points are in bijection with the disjoint union over admissible φ of S_tau(phi0)(φ). The bijection is equivariant for geometric Φ_r2, ZG2(Qp) and A(G2); tau∈I_phi^ad(Af) depends only on the adjoint class φ0.

items.name: Untwisted and refined Langlands–Rapoport statements
items.statement: Record Conjectures3.3.7 and3.7.8 as predicates asserting the untwisted equivariant bijection and the refined component-compatible diagram. This paper proves M07 with tau, and does not supply a proof field for either general untwisted predicate.

api.name: Kisin17.M08.characterisation

api.name: Kisin17.M08.map
api.statement: Transport an actual witness along the admitted comparison; no witness is manufactured from the definition.

items.statement: Kisin2010 Lemma1.5.2 requires Lie(H) stable under h↦φhφ^−1; with that condition the iterated series remains Lie(H)-valued.

items.statement: The construction of Kisin2010 §1.5.4 has connection coefficients in Lie(G), not in general Lie(U_G°); the original1.5.3 is deleted.

items.name: Horizontal tensor locus over the rational completion
items.statement: Complete R[1/p] and R_G[1/p] at the deformation origin, parallel-transport s_alpha to σ_alpha, and define A′_G as the largest closed formal subspace on which every σ_alpha lies in Fil0.

api.name: Kisin17.E03.mk
api.statement: Construct the horizontal sections with specified value at the origin.

api.name: Kisin17.E03.characterisation
api.statement: The locus is cut out by their images in the quotient by Fil0.

api.name: Kisin17.E03.map
api.statement: Pullback along compatible formal maps transports the horizontal tensors.

items.statement: A′_G=A_G in E03; the tangent calculation uses the Frobenius-compatible dual-number maps and regularity of A_G.

items.name: Corrected adapted-factorization proof
items.statement: The proof of Kisin2010 Proposition1.5.8 is repaired by Frobenius-invariance implying horizontality, Fil0 of the lifted tensors, and E04; Proposition1.5.8 and Corollary1.5.11 retain their statements.

items.name: Finite-index central control of the descent kernel
items.statement: For Δ(G,G2)=ker(A(G)→A(G2)), its intersection with the indicated quotient of ZG(Af^p) has finite index; the analogous derived-central intersection has finite index in Δ°. The kernel itself need not be finite.

items.name: Integral descent through finite actions at suitable levels
items.statement: Using E06, Δ° acts through a finite quotient at sufficiently small finite away-p levels. Form the inverse-level quotient to construct the abelian-type integral model and verify its extension property through the levels away from an additional prime.

items.name: Abstract group extension
items.statement: An abstract extension of groups has injective kernel map, surjective quotient map, and range equal to kernel. This is only the algebraic carrier of a Galois gerb.

api.statement: Construct the two homomorphisms and exactness witnesses.

api.name: Kisin17.L19.characterisation
api.statement: Expose injectivity, surjectivity and range-kernel equality.

api.name: Kisin17.L19.map
api.statement: Use compatible homomorphisms of exact diagrams.

items.name: Ordinary comma-category carrier
items.statement: For functors L:A→T and R:B→T, Comma L R has objects a,b and a morphism L(a)→R(b); comparison is not required invertible.

api.name: Kisin17.L20.mk
api.statement: Construct the left and right objects and comparison morphism.

api.name: Kisin17.L20.characterisation
api.statement: Arrow squares define its morphisms.

api.name: Kisin17.L20.map
api.statement: Functorial diagrams induce the corresponding comma functors.

uses.how: Functorial diagrams induce the corresponding comma functors.

items.name: Monoidal-category carrier
items.statement: A monoidal category has tensor, unit, associator, unitors and coherence laws. The pinned general carrier does not impose strictness, invertibility of every arrow or the Picard commutativity data.

api.name: Kisin17.L21.mk
api.statement: Supply tensor structure and the coherence laws.

api.name: Kisin17.L21.characterisation
api.statement: Use associators and unitors rather than definitional associativity.

api.name: Kisin17.L21.map
api.statement: Monoidal functors must retain unit and tensor comparisons.

uses.how: Monoidal functors must retain unit and tensor comparisons.

items.name: Finite field-extension Hilbert 90
items.statement: For fields K⊂L with [FiniteDimensional K L], H1 of the representation of Aut_K(L) on L× has a unique element. This is the finite algebra-automorphism/unit-module theorem; profinite nonabelian GLn and arbitrary tori need separate adapters.

items.name: Integral crystalline tensors for a p-divisible group
items.statement: Let G be a p-divisible group over O_K with G_K-invariant tensors (s_α) ⊂ T_pG^⊗ defining a reductive G ⊂ GL(T_pG), and suppose k is separably closed, or G_{Z_p} is connected and k finite. Then (1) the comparison images s_{α,0} lie in D(G)(W)^⊗; (2) there is an isomorphism T_pG*(−1) ⊗ W ≅ D(G) taking s_α to s_{α,0}; (3) the filtration on D(G)(k) is induced by a G_W-valued cocharacter.

items.name: Hodge cocharacter and Frobenius double coset
items.statement: The filtration on D(G)(k) is given by a G_W-valued cocharacter μ_0^{-1}, and b ∈ G_W(W) p^{υ_0} G_W(W) with υ_0 = σ(μ_0).

items.name: Crystalline realization of the Hodge tensors at a point
items.statement: (1) Under the p-adic comparison isomorphism the s_{α,p,x̃} map to φ-invariant tensors s_{α,0,x̃} ∈ Fil⁰(H¹_cris(A_x/W)^⊗). (2) There is a W-linear isomorphism H¹_ét(A_{x̃,K̄}, Z_p) ⊗ W ≅ H¹_cris(A_x/W) taking s_{α,p,x̃} to s_{α,0,x̃}; the s_{α,0,x̃} define a reductive G_W ≅ G_{Z(p)} ⊗ W. (3) The filtration on H¹_cris(A_x/W) ⊗ k is given by μ_0^{-1} with μ_0 conjugate to μ_h.

items.name: Decomposition of S_τ(G, φ_0) by admissible lifts
items.statement: The natural map ∐_{[φ], φ^ad = φ_0} S_τ(φ) → S_τ(G, φ_0) is a bijection, where [φ] runs over representatives of the conjugacy classes of admissible morphisms φ: Q → G_G lifting φ_0.

items.name: Dependence of the pair (S_τ(G, φ_0)^+, E_p(G, φ_0))
items.statement: The pair (S_τ(G, φ_0)^+, E_p(G, φ_0)), as a set with a group action, depends only on τ, φ_0, G^der_{Z(p)} and X^+; morphisms in SH_p(G^ad, X^ad)^+ inducing isomorphisms on derived groups induce functorial isomorphisms of the pairs.
